title: Imperial Walkers
description: Imperial Walkers stomp stealthily through the frozen geysers of Hoth (front), another new image by Ralph McQuarrie from THE ILLUSTRATED STAR WARS UNIVERSE. What if the Empire had built two Death Stars simultaneously, the artist seems to be asking (back). The STAR WARS trilogy was a true collaboration. "There was a lot of cross-pollination among artists, and we also incorporated what George said before coming up with a final design," McQuarrie says.
